Based on the image provided, here are the precise answers to your questions:

(a) The M is **SOLID FILLED** with gradient colors (cyan on the left and violet/purple on the right). It is not a wireframe or outline.
(b) The M strokes are **thick and bold**, forming a substantial, solid geometric shape rather than thin lines.
(c) **Yes**, there is a white wordmark below the emblem. It says exactly: **"MTQΣ"** (using the Greek letter Sigma at the end).
(d) **No**, there is no tagline visible below the wordmark in this specific image.
